items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Glennie with the bass' in the context of Rene's band, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Glennie.

ctx.x: Remember any of the guys that Rene would have in his band?
What's up? Uh, Glennie with the bass. Oh yeah? Oh yeah, ooh. That's his, that's his R's, Rene's R's. One man Glennie. His ace. Let's see.
I think Sonny Henry, I think he played trombone a lot.
